action_items.text: The Marketing Expert will prepare a report on trendwatching.

decisions.text: The remote will not feature speech recognition.
The remote will not feature an LCD screen.
The remote will light up when a button is pressed, much like a mobile phone.
Complicated features will be hidden from the more simple functions on the main interface.
The remote will feature teletext capabilities.
The teletext buttons will be included on the main interface.
